title: Spelling L.C. Pelche and where Red Dugall lived
summary: Allen asks about the spelling of saxophonist L.C. Pelche's name and where Red Dugall lived and died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Let me see. Uh... Ask him how you spell this guy, L.C. Pelche's name.
He said, how do you spell this fella, L.C. Pelche's name? L.C.?
How do you spell it? I forgot how to spell Pelche's name. He asked him. See, something like that.
Yeah, okay. Ask him where did Red Dugall live? Where did he live?

Yeah, you might know. He said, where did Red Dugall live? Where did he live? Down in the first quarter, you know, when he was there. He died suddenly there. He died. I don't like his... Yeah. I said, what was he going to get talking about dying now? Ask him did he know Herb Moran? Did you know Herb Moran? Who?
